# Test fixtures

Small verification tasks used by the golden tests. They are copies of files from
the [SV-Benchmarks](https://gitlab.com/sosy-lab/benchmarking/sv-benchmarks) and
[sv-witnesses](https://gitlab.com/sosy-lab/benchmarking/sv-witnesses) repositories
and keep their original license headers:

| Directory | Origin | License |
|---|---|---|
| `common/`, `properties/`, `MinePump/` | sv-benchmarks `java/` | Apache-2.0 (SPDX headers in the files) |
| `jbmc-regression/` | sv-benchmarks `java/jbmc-regression` | 4-clause BSD, see `jbmc-regression/LICENSE` |
| `jdart-regression/` | sv-benchmarks `java/jdart-regression` | MIT, see `jdart-regression/LICENSE-MIT` |
| `sv-witnesses/` | sv-witnesses `examples/java` (the GDart example witness and its task) | Apache-2.0, see `sv-witnesses/LICENSE.Apache-2.0.txt` |
| `synthetic/` | written for these tests | same license as this repository |
